questions.cardDe: Was stand zu DDR-Zeiten auf dem Gelände der Berliner BND-Zentrale: Stadion der Weltjugend, Staatsratsgebäude oder Palasthotel?

questions.en: Which stadium stood in GDR times on the site of today's BND (Federal Intelligence Service) headquarters in Berlin?
questions.answerEn: Stadion der Weltjugend (Stadium of World Youth)

timeline.labelEn: Stadion der Weltjugend in East Berlin, from its opening to its demolition
timeline.labelDe: Stadion der Weltjugend in Ost-Berlin, von der Eröffnung bis zum Abriss

questions.notes: Opened in 1950 as Walter-Ulbricht-Stadion, demolished in 1992; the BND headquarters was built on the site from 2006 to 2018.
